children: Excess liquidity in India's equity market has contributed to underperformance and may continue to do so, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said in an interview with CNBC published on Sunday.
“Because of the ease of liquidity, ease of availability, people are even exiting easily” from equities, Sitharaman said, adding that the fundamentals of the Indian economy are fine.
